revise.best_time: A whole day: go up on the first cable cars, before the queues

claim.finding: Wikipedia: a 5.8 km cable car (one of six) to a hill station at 1,500 m; the Golden Bridge, the French Village and the Fantasy Park are all at the top. A first visit that rides up, walks the bridge and the village and sees the park takes the day; tours from Đà Nẵng run 8:00 to 17:00.

revise.best_time: Half a day: late afternoon into the evening, for the lanterns

claim.finding: Wikivoyage: the lantern boats run 16:00 to 22:00, and the town ticket covers five of the old houses, halls and museums. Walking the streets, two or three of those sights and the river at dusk is half a day; the houses and halls are also listed on their own.
Wikivoyage (Hội An): "well worth a morning or afternoon trip"; the largest mountain has temples and caves (Huyền Không, Âm Phủ). Climbing Thủy Sơn and seeing the caves takes two to three hours.

revise.best_time: Half a day from Hội An with the ride: go at opening, before the heat

claim.finding: Wikivoyage: group tours from Hội An last about 6 hours with only about an hour at the ruins, which it calls too short. Two to two and a half hours on site, with the ride of about an hour each way, is half a day.

revise.best_time: A whole day from Hội An: boats leave around 8:00 and return mid-afternoon

claim.finding: Wikivoyage: day tours pick up at 07:00, sail at 08:00 (30 minutes by speedboat, 1¼ hours by wooden boat), visit the pagoda, the market and a snorkelling beach with lunch, and return around 15:00.

revise.best_time: Most of a morning or an afternoon round the peninsula

places.why: Visit length 240 to 180 minutes. Estimate: the loop road, the Lady Buddha at Linh Ứng and Bàn Cờ peak by motorbike or car take three hours; no source with a length could be reached. The two sights are also listed on their own.

revise.best_time: Ridden as half a day from Đà Nẵng, or on the way to Huế

claim.finding: Wikivoyage: "a great day trip from Da Nang (or Hoi An)" by motorbike. The place is the top of the pass (Hải Vân Quan); an hour there with the ride as travel.

revise.best_time: Evening: arrive by 19:00 for the show at 20:00

places.why: Visit length 90 to 150 minutes. Estimate: the evening show lasts about an hour and the park is walked before it; no source with a length could be reached.
Visit length 90 to 120 minutes. Estimate, as My Khe and the other beaches: two hours.

revise.best_time: Morning: the coaster queues grow from mid-morning

claim.finding: Vietnamese Wikipedia: a 1,000 m alpine coaster takes visitors down to the falls and back, and a rope course has opened beside them. The falls, the coaster both ways and its queues come to two and a half hours; canyoning there makes it half a day.
Vietnamese Wikipedia: the valley and the Mộng Mơ hill are now one park (TTC World), with the lake, gardens and rides. Two and a half hours for a first visit.

revise.best_time: Morning, with the cable car from Robin Hill

claim.finding: Wikivoyage: best reached by the cable car over the pine forest; the monastery and its gardens look over Tuyền Lâm lake. The ride, the monastery and the lake shore take an hour and a half.

revise.best_time: Half the morning: up by jeep, or walk 1.5 to 2 hours

claim.finding: Vietnamese Wikipedia: the jeep takes 15 minutes to the Radar hill (walking 1.5 to 2 hours); the higher Bà peak is a harder walk. Three hours is right for the jeep, the top and the village below.

places.why: Visit length kept at 180 minutes; the note now says how long the trip around it takes.

revise.best_time: Most of a morning: start walking around 4am for sunrise, down by 9 to 10am

claim.finding: Wikivoyage: an easy climb of about 2 hours with a required guide; pre-dawn climbs timed for sunrise are the norm. With the wait at the top and the descent it is six hours, after a pick-up in the night.

revise.best_time: From 4:30pm: the cliff temple at sunset, then the Kecak dance at 6pm

claim.finding: Wikivoyage: the Kecak dance is performed at the temple daily from 18:00 to 19:00 and tickets sell out. The temple walk before it and the dance come to two and a half hours.

revise.best_time: A whole day from Bali by fast boat, with the other west-coast sights

claim.finding: Wikivoyage: most visitors come on day trips from Bali by fast boat. The viewpoint is an hour and a half (the climb down to the beach is longer); Nusa Penida as a whole is a day.

places.why: Visit length kept at 90 minutes; the note now says how long the trip around it takes.
Visit length 45 to 90 minutes. Estimate: walking down into the terraces and back up takes an hour and a half; no source with a length could be reached.

claim.finding: Wikivoyage: the temple stands on a rock a few metres offshore, past a maze of souvenir shops, with a footpath to the cliffs south of it for the views; busiest before sunset. An hour and a half.

revise.best_time: Early: the queue for the gate photograph can take an hour or more

places.why: Visit length 60 to 150 minutes. Estimate: the gate of the lower temple, its photograph queue and the shuttle up; no source with a length could be reached.
